alternates.fact: In 1983, Fela Kuti nominated himself for president in Nigeria's first elections in decades, but his candidature was refused.
alternates.why: I know Fela as the guy who sang 'Zombie' at the army, not as a man who tried to put his own name on the ballot — that flip is what makes me send it.
alternates.title: Fela Kuti
alternates.claim: Fela Kuti once ran for president of Nigeria.
